run_slurm_pipeline: run a datatrove SlurmPipelineExecutor to download and convert a HuggingFace dataset on a Slurm cluster
create_parquet_reader: create a ParquetReader that reads parquet files from a HuggingFace dataset with default metadata
create_jsonl_writer: create a JsonlWriter that writes pipeline output to compressed JSONL files with size limits
build_slurm_executor: build a SlurmPipelineExecutor with 64 tasks, 64 CPUs per task, and a 12-hour time limit
test_pipeline_execution: test the datatrove pipeline execution with ParquetReader and JsonlWriter on a Slurm cluster
